tutorial.title: Welcome to Aegis
tutorial.subtitle: Your intelligent draft assistant and counter-pick advisor for Honor of Kings.
tutorial.step_bubble_desc: Launch the floating bubble to see live counter-picks and build suggestions directly over Honor of Kings during drafts.
tutorial.step_draft_desc: Track enemy selections to instantly identify high-impact counter heroes, synergy combos, and composition strengths.
tutorial.step_builds_desc: Adapt your build path with situational item swaps targeted specifically against the enemy team's damage types and threats.
tutorial.step_packs_desc: Download community-verified portrait and item packs for high-definition visuals.
tutorial.step1_desc: Aegis helps you gain a competitive edge in every ranked match by analyzing hero compositions, 400+ verified counter-picks, meta tier rankings, item builds, and battle spell choices.
tutorial.step2_desc: Pick ally and enemy heroes in real-time to uncover direct counters, 2.5x lane advantages, meta tier strengths, team synergies, and recommended situational items.
tutorial.step3_desc: Select your hero and 5 enemy champions to get a tailored 6-item counter build, optimal battle spell, and situational swap items.
tutorial.step4_desc: Toggle this switch to launch an overlay bubble that floats directly over your game. View live counter advice, select lanes, and flip the Pro/Internal toggle switch right in the overlay header without leaving the game!
tutorial.step5_desc: Aegis can recommend ANY champion, or you can restrict suggestions strictly to your preferred roles (Farm Lane, Roaming, Jungle, etc.) and selected comfort hero pool.
tutorial.step6_desc: Aegis features a 100% offline Internal Engine powered by 400+ verified counter matchups, competitive tier ratings, and 2.5x lane advantages. Easily toggle between Internal and Pro AI on the Homescreen, Draft Analyzer, and inside the In-Game Floating Overlay!

key_tutorial.video_title: Watch How to Get & Paste Your Key
key_tutorial.video_desc: A quick visual guide showing where to click on Google AI Studio to generate your free key.
key_tutorial.step1_desc: Go to Google AI Studio. Sign in using any standard Google account. (No credit card or payment required).
key_tutorial.step2_desc: In the left sidebar or top right, click '+ Create API key'. Then select 'Create key in new project'.
key_tutorial.step3_desc: Your generated key begins with 'AIzaSy...'. Tap the Copy icon beside the key.
key_tutorial.step4_desc: Return here, paste the key into the Gemini API Key box, and tap Save. You are all set for Pro Cloud AI!
key_tutorial.privacy_note: Your API key is stored strictly on your local device. It is never transmitted to any third-party server besides Google's official Gemini API.
